spec.title: Conformance corpus under JBMC and --engine auto: no Verified the JVM refutes (closes VF-001 with its sibling when both pass)
spec.description:
Resubmitted unchanged by the cleanup-jbmc stream after VF-009's fix: VF-001 (verification/findings.md) closes when this job and 20261107-172721-conformance-corpus-under-engine-auto-con pass. Each part of VF-001 was fixed earlier (nlvopkvx for the seven strict Verifieds and auto's pass-through, svvrpymr and xzvyuwxp for caught and nestedHandler; see llm-dlc/loops/cleanup-jbmc.md); this job runs every ignored conformance test, --confirm's included, which VF-009 kept failing. The steps are the original job's.

Step 1d of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md. lib/tests/conformance.rs holds 54 small Java methods (lib/tests/conformance/conformance/Conformance.java) with 93 claims, 48 of which a real JVM refutes. The cases cover the gaps and their reproducers (a negative capacity to ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet and StringBuilder; synchronized (null); Random.nextBytes), field hiding, literal identity, class initializers that throw, exceptions (finally overriding a return, nested handlers, bounds, casts, throw null, rethrow), aliasing, null arrays, record constructors, virtual and default-method dispatch, and arithmetic edge cases (MIN_VALUE / -1, negative remainders, shift counts out of range, narrowing, overflow). A Java runner executes every call and every claim's generated harness on the JVM. The test run inline covers the tool's own checker under --gaps strict and assume. This job runs the ignored test, which puts every claim through --engine jbmc and --engine auto under --gaps strict. It fails if either engine says Verified for a claim the JVM refutes, or reports a violation whose witness does not refute the harness on the JVM.
spec.expected: exits 0: the_corpus_agrees_with_the_jvm_under_jbmc_and_auto passes. The log lists each claim's verdict per engine. A failure lists each disagreement with the JVM, which is a finding about JBMC or the adapter to triage under the brief's Progress, not something to retry.
